maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from building and selling new homes; mortgage, title and insurance arms are small ancillary businesses.

publicly_funded.reason: Buyers are private consumers purchasing new single-family homes, townhomes and condos, financed by private mortgages.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by building and selling homes across its markets, with only occasional homebuilder acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Homebuyers choose among many builders before purchase; no ongoing switching cost for a one-time new home purchase.
